noun_definition: Book travel refers to the action of initiating a travel booking process through the user interface on the specified website.

Book travel animation refers to the visual effect or transition that occurs when the user initiates the booking process for travel, which should remain visible and not become blank when the RHP (Right Hand Panel) is dismissed.
rhp refers to a user interface element that is dismissed during the process of booking travel, which should not cause the associated animation to become blank.
